answer: NovaOps does not allow employees to use a personal laptop for work, except for a five-business-day IT continuity exception when a managed laptop is being repaired or replaced and the employee has no working device. IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for those five days. All equipment remains NovaOps property, and employees are expected to take reasonable care of it. Accidental damage during normal use is covered by IT at no cost to the employee; loss or damage from clear negligence may be charged back at IT's discretion, case by case. All equipment must be returned through IT at offboarding or role change​​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops] [documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Care and return].

During the five-business-day IT continuity exception, IT must approve and log the use of a personal laptop before the employee can use it, even for those five days. This is required to ensure proper oversight and documentation of the exception​​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops].
The Equipment Policy is owned by IT, effective 2026-06-01​​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § (whole document)].
